# Simple access for one person, appointment preview per frame
### New
- **Simple access for one person (for example a grandmother):** at the frame under *⚙ → Simple access for one person* you create an access (name, Immich e-mail and password of that person's account; only your own revocable key without delete rights is stored). You get a **link and QR code** to a very simple page with big buttons: **add photos** (they land in the person's own Immich account), **make a new show** (tap photos, show now or save with a name), **my shows** (show, delete) and **back to the normal programme**. The person sees and changes nothing else in the app and can only point at the frame you entered; the link can be revoked at any time. Available in all five languages. For an outside address with restricted paths, `/einfach/` and `/api/einfach/` must be allowed and more than 1 MB for `/api/einfach/hochladen` (see README, "A frame in another place").
- **Appointment preview per frame:** under *Devices → ⚙ → Calendar* you decide whether the frame looks ahead when nothing is left today, and for how many days: **0** = today only, **1** = tomorrow too (default, as before), up to **14** days. The frame shows what is still due today, otherwise the next day with appointments within that window, with weekday and date ("Wed 21.10. 09:00 Pilates"). Applies to appointments from the calendar link; phone appointments still know only today and tomorrow.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
